blocking.issue: Regression in the area's own never-cut item (L4h-left-1). Chat's 'mark it done anyway' with the person's own words as a note is now refused. Before, it answered the failed task's card. moveAsCardAnswer returns null (keeps the move) for any card option that takes no note when the note is the person's. It never checks whether the move itself is allowed. A failed or needs_human task cannot move to done (packages/state/src/workflow.ts TASK_TRANSITIONS: failed and needs_human go only to ready or cancelled). So task.transition to done hits assertMove and is refused. The person's words, meant to be kept and answered, now block the answer.
blocking.evidence: A probe (written and deleted again) in packages/commands/test, built like chat-final.test.ts's failedWithCard (medium-risk card, options Try again / Mark done anyway / Cancel task), executor.execute task.transition {task:'digest', to:'done', note:'the client accepted it as it is'}, ctx actor agent, source chat, onPersonsWords, wordsUsed 'mark the digest page done anyway, the client accepted it as it is'. On HEAD 8288019: {status:'refused', reason:'"Write the digest page" is failed now, so it cannot be done; nothing changed.'}. With the model's own note, or no note: pending request.answer 'Mark done anyway ("Write the digest page" failed)?'. On base claude/nifty-knuth-f9udt0 (base task.ts, request.ts and executor.ts), all three cases give the pending request.answer 'Mark done anyway (...)?' read-back. The same refusal follows from a voice turn, and from any card that offers Mark done anyway.
blocking.expected: Keep the move only when it is a move the task can make (canTransition from its status; Cancel task: yes; Mark done anyway from failed/needs_human: no). Otherwise answer the card with its option, and say that the person's note was not kept, as the high-risk path already does ('..., and your note was not kept.'), or carry the note. Add a failing-first case for Mark done anyway with the person's own note: in commands/test/chat-final.test.ts, plus the read-back or reply the person sees.

Better to leave the note clause out, or quote the note (packages/commands/src/executor.ts, the `whose` and `filed` lines).

The answer_on_card reply uses the model's raw `answer` string (`String(params?.answer ?? "it")`), not the matched option's label. A lower-case 'try again', or a missing answer ('with it'), would reach the person as is.

appliedChanges matches left_out lines by prefix (startsWith). A change whose line is a prefix of another, left-out change's line is wrongly treated as left out.
waits_for_you is computed at apply time. Once the person does that task, the Answered line still says the changed task waits for it, as the existing 'your next Start runs it' line already does.

settleProposal's compare-and-set returns 'skipped' on any version bump between list and update, including unrelated writes. The card then waits for the next sync (an answer, the poll when remote is on, or a restart).

finishTakeOuts pages through every answered decision card of the person on every syncPrAnswers. A crash after the pull request was opened but before the merge record was written would open a second take-out. The live check ('exactly one take-out pull request') depends on that order.
